scenes.text: ChatGPT now makes *animated GIFs* from a sentence or a photo, and lets you *edit the frames*

scenes.title: What *changed*
lines: Nov 4: OpenAI's Images 2.6 model rolled out to all ChatGPT users on web, desktop and mobile, Codex included.
Type 'make a GIF of a cat dancing' or upload a photo. Then change the speed or fix single frames before you share it.

scenes.title: The *money use*
lines: Animated product teasers for your store's emails and posts. GIF stickers for a brand's GIPHY channel. Animated emotes for streamers.
Sellers on Fiverr and Etsy already charge for animated emotes and stickers. Round one now takes a sentence; you sell the polish.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: OpenAI has not published GIF length, frame count or per-plan limits yet, so expect short, looping clips and a daily cap on free accounts.
OpenAI says over 4 billion images a week now, 1 billion more than September. Source: The Verge; The Decoder, Nov 4, 2026.

scenes.title: The *cost*
lines: ChatGPT Free: $0 with limited image generations a day. Plus: $20 a month for more. No extra charge for GIFs.

scenes.text: What would you *animate first*: a product, a sticker or a meme? *Comment* below.
